summary: C.E., 51, and D.H., 26, separated from their party near Mirror Lake in Rocky Mountain National Park (last seen 2:30 p.m.); located cold and hungry but uninjured above Hague Creek below Mummy Pass; helicopter to the east side.
location: Mirror Lake / Hague Creek, below Mummy Pass, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. SARDOC July 22 2015 mission report corroboration: two women, 26 and 53, from a party of 5 (3 males, 2 females) who reached Mirror Lake; the men and women separated briefly and the women were missing. Two SARDOC dog teams searched from ~01:00 7/22 until ~18:30 near the Mummy Pass/Mirror Lake trail intersection; RMNP rangers joined a unified command and took over as IC; on the morning of 7/23 RMNP personnel found the two women, hungry and cold but in good condition. DISCREPANCIES: NPS compendium has ages 51/26, PLS near Mirror Lake in RMNP, county Grand; SARDOC has ages 26/53, PLS at Corral Creek TH off Long Draw Rd, county Larimer. Treated as the same incident (same geography, composition, outcome); row date kept at the compendium's 7/21.
